name: Tarkop Rechnungsmanager für Handwerker
author: tarkop

sections.description:
Tarkop Rechnungsmanager für Handwerker helps German tradespeople and freelancers create and manage invoices in the WordPress administration area.

The plugin stores invoice and company data in the site’s own WordPress database. It does not transmit invoice data to an external service.

Features

  • Configure company, tax, bank, and payment information
  • Create and manage an unlimited number of sender profiles, each with its own § 19 UStG setting
  • Search sender profiles by profile or company name directly in the invoice editor
  • Reuse and quickly search recently entered customer details
  • Generate continuous invoice numbers
  • Manage invoices in a dedicated administration menu
  • Add line items with quantities, units, prices, discounts, and VAT rates
  • Calculate net amounts, 19% or 7% VAT, and gross totals
  • Create invoices for businesses using the small-business regulation (§ 19 UStG)
  • Open a print-optimized A4 invoice view and save it as PDF using the browser’s print dialog

The plugin supports common invoice fields used in Germany, but it does not provide tax or legal advice. Users remain responsible for checking their invoices and retention processes against the requirements that apply to their business.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tarkop-rechnungsmanager-handwerker folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Settings > Rechnung and enter the default sender details.
  4. Open Rechnungen > Neue Rechnung to create an invoice.
  5. Add customer data and line items, publish the invoice, and use the PDF button to open the printable view.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin guarantee legal or GoBD compliance?

No. It provides fields and calculations useful for German invoices, but it does not replace advice from a tax adviser or lawyer. The site owner is responsible for invoice content, numbering, storage, and all applicable requirements.

Which VAT rates are supported?

Line items can use 19%, 7%, or 0% VAT. The small-business setting suppresses VAT calculation and adds the corresponding invoice treatment for § 19 UStG.

Where is invoice data stored?

Invoice data, sender profiles, and recent customer details are stored locally in the WordPress database. The plugin does not send this data to an external server.

Can I use multiple sender profiles?

Yes. You can create, edit, and delete as many additional sender profiles as needed.

How is the PDF created?

The plugin opens a print-optimized invoice page. Choose “Save as PDF” in your browser’s print dialog.
